records.trigger_text: interchangeability | replacement approval | shared nomenclature
records.rule: Shared nomenclature, nearby figures, or part-family similarity are not proof of interchangeability or replacement approval.
records.good_behavior: Say what TRACE-Net can prove about each part, then state interchangeability/replacement approval is not proven.
records.bad_behavior: Treating the same description or part-family proximity as approval or interchangeability.
records.source: H14C llm smoke repair

records.trigger_text: installation safety | fit approval | aircraft effectivity
records.rule: Figure/part identification evidence does not prove installation safety, fit approval, aircraft effectivity, or replacement approval.
records.good_behavior: Lead with not proven, then list the source-trace-ready identity/nomenclature evidence that is proven.
records.bad_behavior: Implying a figure, OCR line, or part listing authorizes installation or fit.
records.source: H14C llm smoke repair

records.trigger_text: v2 summary | summary-only proof
records.rule: V2 summaries may guide planning and framing, but cannot prove source claims; factual claims require proof_context citations.
records.good_behavior: Use summaries only to guide route selection and answer framing; cite proof_context for claims.
records.bad_behavior: Using a v2 summary as direct evidence for part identity or approval.
records.source: H10/H14C semantic eval

records.trigger_text: visual route | OCR nomenclature | nomenclature missing
records.rule: visual_figure_link establishes figure-to-part identity; ocr_nomenclature provides OCR-backed line-text name proof.
records.good_behavior: Explain both routes separately when asked evidence-support or pipeline questions.
records.bad_behavior: Saying only 'not proven' for pipeline questions when route behavior evidence is available.
records.source: H14C safe reasoning traces

records.trigger_text: table OCR | exact part lookup | evidence support
records.rule: Exact-part/table-OCR evidence supports presence of a part number but does not by itself prove approvals or compatibility.
records.good_behavior: Use table/OCR evidence to support part presence and citation readiness, while keeping approval claims out of scope.
records.bad_behavior: Converting a table hit into effectivity, fit, or replacement authority.
records.source: H11-H14C smoke evals

records.trigger_text: engineering answer | limitations | evidence
records.rule: Prefer answer sections: Answer, Evidence, Engineering confidence, Limits; for limitations questions, split Can prove vs Cannot prove.
records.good_behavior: Give a concise direct answer, then cite proof and state limits.
records.bad_behavior: Generic disclaimer-only answers, or citation dumps without answering the actual intent.
records.source: H14C llm answer style

records.trigger_text: not proven | cannot prove | not source-trace-ready
records.rule: When a claim is not proven, still explain what TRACE-Net can prove and why the requested claim is outside the evidence.
records.good_behavior: Not proven + can prove identity/nomenclature/pages + cannot prove approval/safety/effectivity.
records.bad_behavior: Only saying 'not proven' without useful evidence context.
records.source: H13 over-refusal repair through H14C

records.trigger_text: unknown part | unknown figure | not found
records.rule: For unknown part/figure questions with no proof_context, lead with not found / not source-trace-ready and do not cite unrelated evidence.
records.good_behavior: State no proof_context was available and avoid unrelated citations.
records.bad_behavior: Citing nearby known figures or parts for an unknown requested identifier.
records.source: H14C partial unknown handling

records.trigger_text: pipeline/debug questions over-refused
records.rule: H13/H14 initially answered pipeline/debug questions with generic 'not proven'; H14C repaired this using scaffold + route-specific intent rules.
records.good_behavior: Explain route behavior when the scaffold describes pipeline behavior; distinguish pipeline explanation from source-truth proof.
records.bad_behavior: Blank/blocked or generic not-proven answers for route behavior questions.
records.source: H13-H14C eval history

records.trigger_text: Windows path length | missing quality_check
records.rule: H14B exposed nested stage-output path failures; H14C used shorter output dirs and safe trace records to prevent blocked answers.
records.good_behavior: Use short run directories and record safe failure traces instead of letting path plumbing block question evaluation.
records.bad_behavior: Long nested run directories that prevent quality-check artifacts from being written/read on Windows.
records.source: H14B/H14C path hardening

records.trigger_text: Self-RAG answer behavior critique
records.rule: Self-RAG should check whether the draft obeys source-trace boundaries, answers the actual intent, cites claims, and avoids over/under-refusal.
records.good_behavior: Critique answers for evidence support and behavior correctness before delivery.
records.bad_behavior: Only checking citation existence while missing semantic intent failure.
records.source: H10 semantic answer quality eval

records.trigger_text: CRAG repair | weak answer retry
records.rule: CRAG should retrieve relevant failure/repair engrams and regenerate or rewrite the answer when Self-RAG flags weak behavior or weak evidence.
records.good_behavior: Use retrieved repair patterns such as 'shared nomenclature is not interchangeability' to fix weak drafts.
records.bad_behavior: Retrying the same prompt without adding behavior memory or evidence diagnostics.
records.source: TRACE-Net engram architecture plan

records.trigger_text: LLM smoke eval history
records.rule: Observed eval result: 28 GOOD, 2 PARTIAL, 0 BAD, 0 BLOCKED out of 30; unsupported_claim_count=0.
records.good_behavior: Reuse high-performing answer patterns and keep safety counters at zero.
records.bad_behavior: Ignore prior eval failures or regress on unsupported claims.
records.source: local_data/organization/trace_net/llm_h14c_30/trace_net_engineering_llm_answer_smoke_v1.json

records.trigger_text: partial category: unknown_figure
records.rule: Category 'unknown_figure' was graded PARTIAL in a smoke eval; retrieve a more specific answer pattern before drafting.
records.good_behavior: Explain the boundary and the available proof rather than generic refusal.
records.bad_behavior: Generic not-proven or incomplete answer for a known weak category.
records.source: local_data/organization/trace_net/llm_h14c_30/trace_net_engineering_llm_answer_smoke_v1.json

records.trigger_text: partial category: unknown_part
records.rule: Category 'unknown_part' was graded PARTIAL in a smoke eval; retrieve a more specific answer pattern before drafting.

records.trigger_text: direct NHA | next higher assembly | immediate parent
records.rule: A direct NHA is exactly one source-supported parent hop; never substitute a grandparent or top assembly.
records.good_behavior: Apply the rule as behavior guidance, then require current real source evidence before making a factual claim.
records.bad_behavior: Treating the atom, skill card, example, or synthetic benchmark as proof of a current relationship.
